lines.text: Count by tens from zero, then look between the marks.
Tap the line where 0 point 8 5 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 1 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 600 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where 9 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where negative 8 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where the square root of 99 goes. Then launch!
Tap the line where two thirds goes. Then launch!
The marks count by 10. Tap the line where 72 goes. Then launch!
The marks count by 10. Tap the line where negative 3 goes. Then launch!
The marks count by 25. Tap the line where 32 goes. Then launch!
